scope: 11 selected form sets, including three same-boss aliases. All source sheets and supplied atlases were visually inspected in comparison contacts; byte/RGBA reconstruction verifies packing, not topology, source approval, temporal playback or engine behavior. No image generation or repainting.

budget.recommendedLoading: Load only active form atlas; no all-atlas texture preload assumed. Numbers exclude GPU copies, browser overhead, originals, 1024 atlases and contacts.

canonicalLimits: b06b-boss-child is an existing boss child form; no extra encounter is added.
b07-boss-human supplies janitor phase0 only, not required bear/wolf/dragon forms.
b08-boss-human supplies white-suit phase0 only, not required brain/screens form.
mb-ep1b06b snow/thorn v3 is explicit canonical selection, not parity with the retained molten/gold vault primary.
Secondary chef/director forms do not satisfy separate main-boss canonical forms.
Static body packing and qualitative identity review do not certify form behavior, motion time/root stability, damaging warning readability or GPU/mobile results.
pendingValidation: runtime body/form binding and required-form implementation
